{{Modifier info
| title = Gold Seal
| image = Gold Seal.png
| type = Seal
| effect = Earn {{money|3}} when this card is played and scores
}}
The '''Gold Seal''' is a [[Seal]] card modifier that gives {{money|3}} if a playing card with this seal is played and scored. A card with a Gold Seal will give an additional {{money|3}} per retrigger, and {{money|0}} if it is debuffed. This effect is very similar to {{Enhancement|Gold}}, but awarding money when played rather than when held in hand.

==Acquisition==
*{{Spectral|Talisman}} adds a Gold Seal to 1 selected card.
*{{J|Certificate}} can create a random playing card with a Gold Seal when the round starts.
*[[Standard Packs]] can contain playing cards with Gold Seals.
*More cards with Gold Seals can be created with the {{Tarot|Death}} Tarot card and {{J|DNA}} if the player already has at least 1 Gold Seal card in their deck.

== Strategy ==
* It is recommended to put Gold Seals on cards intended to be played often, and cards that can naturally be retriggered by certain Jokers, like face cards for {{J|Sock and Buskin}} or 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s for {{J|Hack}}.
* It is always a good idea to play a Gold Seal card, even if it doesn't contribute much to the score, if the player has spare hands. Losing {{money|1}} for playing a hand and gaining at least {{money|3}} back is almost always a good trade-off.

==Synergies==
===[[Jokers]]===
*{{J|Hanging Chad}} can retrigger a Gold Seal 2 additional times, providing an extra {{money|6}}.
*{{J|Sock and Buskin}} gives an extra {{money|3}} per played face card with a Gold Seal.
*{{J|Hack}} is similar to Sock and Buskin, but applies to 2s, 3s, 4s, and 5s instead.
*{{J|Dusk}} gives extra money from all scored Gold Seals on the last hand of the round.
*{{J|Burglar}} allows for more Gold Seals to be scored in a round.
* Economy-based scalers, such as {{J|Bull}}, {{J|Bootstraps}}, and {{J|Flash Card}}, appreciate the extra money brought in by Gold Seals.

===[[Vouchers]]===
*{{V|Grabber}} and {{V|Nacho Tong}} provide more opportunities to score Gold Seals.

===[[Enhancements]]===
* {{Seal|Gold|image=Stone Card.png|link=Stone Cards|name=Stone Cards}} with a Gold Seal can be added to any less than 5 card hand to easily earn {{$|3}}.
* {{Seal|Gold|image=Lucky Card.png|link=Lucky Cards|name=Lucky Cards}} with a Gold Seal will give {{$|4.3}} on average when played.

==Anti-Synergies==
* {{J|Vagabond}} is harder to use as scoring a Gold Seal can bring the player over the {{$|4}} barrier, preventing the player from getting a Tarot card on the next hand.
